metadata.title: Unveiling the Heritage of Krystyna Bednarczyk
metadata.description: A 3D exhibit configuration migrated to v2 with media, audio, links, and spawn behavior declared in config instead of an empty interactives GLB.

metadata.interactionDescription: Click Milkmaid to open the image metadata panel.
Click logo_oficyny to open https://krystynabednarczyk.bluepointart.uk/ in a new browser tab.
The dzbanDystopia node anchors spatial audio. Distance, rolloff, looping, volume, and optional transform behavior are declared in the audio module.

Milkmaid.title: Milkmaid
Milkmaid.description: Jaroslaw Solecki's The Dystopia of an Imitation presents a creative way of exploring the 'matter' of art. The central issue taken up in the work is the sculpting process realised in stone, clay and in the form of digital 3D graphics[...] Quote from the exhibition booklet "The Dystopia of an Imitation"

items.label: About Dystopia of Imitation
items.content: This exhibit is still in its experimental stage. Some things may change, break, or disappear as we keep testing new ideas. You're welcome to look around, try things out, and see how it evolves. Thanks for being part of the experiment!
